meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Matrix 聊天平台收发消息。它会复制并注册适配器、装依赖、修补导入、跑构建测试，再让你填机器人账号凭据。需要单独机器人账号，因为 Matrix 不能给自己发私信。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Matrix 通道，或运行 /setup、/manage-channels 流程中需要集成 Matrix 时触发。

say.note: 会执行复制适配器、安装依赖等步骤。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人账户。
say.note: 引导输入 homeserver、用户名、密码或令牌。

say.text: 把 Matrix 频道连到当前代理组。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can chat over Matrix. It copies and registers the Matrix adapter, installs deps, patches ESM imports, builds, and lets you set bot credentials. A separate bot account is needed since Matrix can't DM yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Matrix channel, or while running /setup or /manage-channels.

say_en.note: Runs the adapter copy and install steps.
Prompts for homeserver, username, password or token.

say_en.text: Connect Matrix to the current agent group.
